Specification of Diagnostics
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
[SWS_DM_02172] Operation
execution with wrong proximity_challenge
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD method to execute an operation is received and the
DiagnosticSov-
dOperation.proximityProofRequired
is set to
TRUE
for this
operation
and
the validation of the
proximity_response
according to [SWS_DM_01395] fails with
kProximityChallengeValidationFailed
, the DM shall deny the request and re-
turn an SOVD error 400 (Bad Request).
⌋
[SWS_DM_02173] Operation
execution with successful proxim-
ity_challenge
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If a SOVD method to execute an operation is received and the
DiagnosticSov-
dOperation.proximityProofRequired
is set to
TRUE
for this
operation
, the
DM shall only process the execution request, if the validation of the
proxim-
ity_response
according to [SWS_DM_01395] succeeds with
kProximityChal-
lengeValidationSuccessful
.
⌋
7.3.3.5.5.4 Operations – Retrieve details of an operation
[SWS_DM_01403] Support of
SOVD
method
Retrieve details of an oper-
ation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262, RS_Diag_04258
⌈
For each
DiagnosticSovdOperation
, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall provide the SOVD method
Query for operations from an Entity
ac-
cording to ASAM SOVD[5][14].
⌋
[SWS_DM_02175] Retrieval of
SOVD
details of an operation
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04262
⌈
If the SOVD method
details of an operation
is received, the DM shall send a
response body according to ASAM SOVD[5][14] and add for the requested
Diagnos-
ticSovdOperation
.
shortName
:
OperationDescription
with the attributes as defined in [SWS_DM_02167]
proximity_challenge
(optional) as defined in [SWS_DM_01398]
modes
(optional) – hint: the SOVD operation mode is
not yet supported
.
⌋
